status: Cargo's detail spec: the bay with its sealed crates (the whole), one crate opening (the arrival), the report card, and the rack the pods land in, handed to Pods. Wireframes 17-cargo-bay.svg to 17d-cargo-nav.svg
note: Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The stage is the frame's (0, 40, 1024, 522); the top bar and the bottom line are the frame's.
stateRule: bay: the whole, the crates sealed in the bay (or none). opening: from ✓ Open the bay until the last crate has opened, one crate at a time, input held (events.opening). report: from the last crate's end until the next press, then bay, empty. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states

conditions.away: the Companion is not in the Caddy: no walk crates; the bay is shut unless a sitting crate is in it
conditions.docked: the bay is open: one sealed crate per crate the Companion brought, at most three, or none

states.shut: away: the bay's lid across the inside
states.open: docked: the inside, the crates on its floor

crates.order: left to right, the order they open; places with no crate show the bay's floor

sitting.places: from the right: the first at 704, a second at 384; walk crates fill from the left; at most three show, walk crates first

lamp.rule: under its crate, at (place.x + 122, 304): the rows lit from the bottom, floor(10 × crateLamp) in sky, the rest hairline; full only when ready

sitting.opens: a ready sitting crate opens after the walk crates, in the same sequence; its ribbon is strings.ribbon.sitting

waiting.when: pods wait in the bay for a free well

pod.note: the collection class, as Pods' collection draws it, rendered at 88×112

rack.rule: the six places of the rack, the same pods in the same order as Pods' collection: an empty well, or its pod; a pod still travelling leaves its well empty until it lands

pods.more: a crate of more than three pods shows three places; each later pod rises in the middle place as the one before leaves it

travel.from: its place in the open crate
travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out; nothing is scaled; a pod never leaves this rectangle

crateIn.when: the Companion docks with crates while Cargo shows

opening.focus: the room; no ring; no key moves it

crate.do: the dither (16 levels) from the bay, or from the crate before, to this crate closer: regions.crate sealed, the ribbon, the rack
the seal tag tears and the lid lifts: sealed → opening → open, its pods in their places
the ribbon shows this crate's words (a cut, no fade)
the counters tick this crate's materials (the top bar's own tick and flash)
each pod travels from the crate to its well (regions.travel), in well order; a pod with no free well stays in the crate
the world turn jumps to the crate's turn (the top bar's tick)

end.do: the dither back to the bay, empty, with the report card over it (state report)

focus.room: the ring on nothing: Cargo has no targets; ✓ does the bottom line's action, the pad does nothing
focus.held: while events.opening holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent; a room key waits until the report shows
focus.report: while the report card shows, any key closes it and also does what it does: ✓ follows the bottom line, ← only closes it, the pad only closes it, a room key closes it and opens its section

confirm.bay: a crate ready to open (walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate): the opening (events.opening); else nothing, no ✓ cap
confirm.report: See the new pods: the jump to Pods (frame.json navigation.jumps); with no new pod, Done: the card closes

back.bay: Home, the ring on the Cargo module
back.report: closes the card: the bay, empty

keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event. Docked while the bay shows: the lid opens (a cut) and the crates slide in (events.crateIn). Lifted while the bay shows: the lid shuts (a cut). During the opening it waits until the report shows

crates.subject: strings.subjects.crates
crates.need: the most pressing notice after the crates (home.json strings.needs)

handoff.rule: a crate's pods land in the rack, the Station's six wells: Pods' collection shows them in the same wells, new until identified. ✓ See the new pods on the report jumps to Pods' collection with the ring on the pod that most needs the player; ← there reads Home. A pod with no free well waits in the bay (regions.waiting) and lands, oldest first, as a well frees

subjects.waitingOne: a pod waits for a well

ribbon.rule: the crate only, no digits; the land's reach is on the report card

placeholders.crate-sealed-256x176: the bay's crate, a rugged field case: enamel body, deepTeal rubber corners, an orange seal tag
placeholders.crate-opening-384x256: the tag torn, the lid lifting
placeholders.crate-open-384x256: the lid off, its fitted cut-outs
placeholders.bay: 992×320 panel; the lid enamel with deepTeal seals
